item.name: Cheese_Station_Storage
item.description: Closed storage container for clean, dry cheese-service tools.
item.readyBeforeUse: The container is clean, dry, and has space for every dry tool.
item.readyForNextPerson: Only clean, fully dry cheese-service tools are inside and the container is closed.
item.ifNotReady: Do not store a wet or dirty food-contact item. Tell the Food Lead.
